name: Uso no Ie -Drujo Demana-
original_name: 嘘の家‐ドルージョ・デマーン‐
source:
You (can be named) are invited to a mansion called "The House of Lie".
There you are asked to feed eight succubi with your lifeforce...
A story of you and ten heroines.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ238949.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
